components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action for adding or moving tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 16px); background: var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); color: var(--color-on-primary, #33443c); padding: 14px 20px; font-family: var(--font-label, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 200ms, background-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--color-primary-high, #c4d3ca); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.1); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 16px); background: var(--color-surface-container-highest, #22262a); color: var(--color-on-surface, #e2e6eb); padding: 12px 16px; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 200ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-bright, #282d31); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Raised charcoal field for quick task entry and inline editing.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { color: var(--color-on-surface-variant, #a8abb0); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.32em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.1); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 16px); background: var(--color-surface-container-highest, #22262a); color: var(--color-on-surface, #e2e6eb); padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(168, 171, 176, 0.7); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.2); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.15); outline: none; }

components.name: Task Card
components.description: Default todo item surface with schedule badge, lifecycle badge, and hover lift.
components.html:
Review next week's commitments

Week 18 · CurrentActive
components.css: .ds-task-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.1); border-radius: var(--radius-surface, 24px); background: var(--color-surface-container, #171a1d); color: var(--color-on-surface, #e2e6eb); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16); transition: transform 300ms, background-color 300ms, box-shadow 300ms, border-color 300ms; } .ds-task-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--color-surface-container-high, #1c2023); border-color: rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24); } .ds-check { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.7); background: transparent; transition: border-color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-check:hover { border-color: rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.7); } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-check:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-task-main { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 14px; } .ds-task-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-task-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-surface-container-high, #1c2023); } .ds-chip { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: var(--font-label, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip-primary { background: rgba(69, 86, 78, 0.35); color: var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); } .ds-chip-neutral { background: var(--color-surface-container-highest, #22262a); color: var(--color-on-surface-variant, #a8abb0); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Inline sync state with a small semantic dot and optional retry action.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.1); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(23, 26, 29, 0.8); color: var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); padding: 8px 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16); font-family: var(--font-label, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); transition: background-color 200ms; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Compact route tab for weekly planning lanes.
components.html: CurrentFuture
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.1); border-radius: 24px; background: rgba(17, 20, 22, 0.7); padding: 4px; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 16px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--color-on-surface-variant, #a8abb0); text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: color 200ms, background-color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); background: var(--color-surface-container, #171a1d); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); background: rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.1); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Floating Composer
components.description: Bottom fixed capture surface that anchors the product gesture.
components.css: .ds-composer { max-width: 48rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: end; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.1); border-radius: var(--radius-surface, 24px); background: rgba(23, 26, 29, 0.9); padding: 14px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38); backdrop-filter: blur(40px); } .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { color: var(--color-on-surface-variant, #a8abb0); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.32em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.1); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 16px); background: var(--color-surface-container-highest, #22262a); color: var(--color-on-surface, #e2e6eb); padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.15); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 16px); background: var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); color: var(--color-on-primary, #33443c); padding: 14px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 200ms, background-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--color-primary-high, #c4d3ca); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(184, 203, 193, 0.18); } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-composer { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

components.css: .ds-empty { border: 1px solid rgba(68, 72, 77, 0.1); border-radius: var(--radius-surface, 24px); background: rgba(23, 26, 29, 0.7); color: var(--color-on-surface, #e2e6eb); padding: 48px 24px; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-empty-icon { width: 64px; height: 64px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface-container-highest, #22262a); color: var(--color-primary, #b8cbc1); } .ds-empty-icon svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; } .ds-empty-title { margin: 16px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-headline, Epilogue, sans-serif); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-empty-text { max-width: 24rem; margin: 8px auto 0; color: var(--color-on-surface-variant, #a8abb0); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; }

narrative.overview:
Pile of Todos is a dim, focused working surface for one person's weekly planning rhythm. It should feel like a dependable desk at the end of a concentrated day: every control is visible, every task has a place, and the interface keeps its voice low while the user decides what matters.

The system is dark because the scene is personal planning in a focused work session, often near the edge of the day when glare feels intrusive and calm contrast helps sustained scanning. It is not a neon productivity toy. The visual language uses soft mechanical controls, quiet tonal layers, and small color signals that confirm state rather than decorate the page.

The product must reject overly bright palettes, loud gradients, massive animations, generic SaaS dashboard tropes, overly cute todo-app styling, marketing-demo polish, neon productivity styling, and generic notes-app cloning.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, tactile surfaces with generous corner rounding and low-contrast borders.
Muted semantic color used for task state, sync confidence, and primary actions only.
A fixed bottom composer that treats capture as the main product gesture.
Dark tonal layering with soft shadows only when a surface floats above the workbench.
Short, practical copy that supports triage without narrating the obvious.

rules.name: The Quiet Signal Rule
rules.body: Sage is for confirmation, current selection, focus, and the primary add gesture. Do not use it as decoration.

rules.name: The Tinted Dark Rule
rules.body: The surface is dark but never pure black. Every neutral must carry a slight blue-green cast so the interface feels like a workbench, not a terminal.

rules.name: The Semantic Pastel Rule
rules.body: Rose, blue, and red are state colors. They explain schedule, sync, or error status. They are forbidden as ornamental accents.

rules.name: The Working Sans Rule
rules.body: UI labels, buttons, badges, and data use Inter. Epilogue is for names and headings only.

rules.name: The Tight Scale Rule
rules.body: This is a product interface. Keep hierarchy tight and fixed. Do not use fluid display sizes or dramatic type jumps.

rules.name: The Tonal First Rule
rules.body: If a surface can be distinguished with color, border opacity, and spacing, do not add a new shadow.

rules.name: The Floating Surface Rule
rules.body: Heavy shadow is reserved for fixed, sticky, or overlay surfaces. A normal card never gets the composer shadow.

dos: Do use the existing dark token stack for all surfaces. The workbench depends on tonal separation, not random grays.
Do reserve sage for primary actions, current selection, focus, synced states, and completed work.
Do keep task capture prominent with the fixed composer. It is the core product gesture.
Do use skeleton states in the existing charcoal layers instead of center-screen spinners.
Do keep motion between `150ms` and `320ms`, using state feedback only.
Do preserve visible focus states on every control, especially task checkboxes, nav items, fields, and week radio options.
Do keep copy short and practical: labels should help capture, triage, move, sync, or archive.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS dashboard tropes.
Don't use overly cute todo-app styling.
Don't make the UI feel like a marketing demo, a neon productivity toy, or a clone of a generic notes app.
Don't use pure black or pure white. Use the tinted neutral system.
Don't use a colored `border-left` or `border-right` stripe greater than `1px` on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts.
Don't add decorative glassmorphism. Existing blur belongs to sticky and floating surfaces only.
Don't create identical marketing-style card grids. This is a task surface.
Don't introduce modals before inline or progressive controls. The current week selector is the exception because it changes a task destination.
Don't use display fonts in UI labels, buttons, badges, or data.
Don't add full-saturation accents to inactive states.
